meta.title: Trigger Point MTrP Dataset
meta.disclaimer: Educational only. Not medical advice. Use under supervision. Stop if sharp, electrical, or nerve-like sensations occur.

points.location: Anterior scalene taut band near upper 1st-rib region (deep lateral neck); palpate with head rotated away.
points.referral: Lateral neck/shoulder; may radiate toward lateral upper arm.
points.protocol: Ischemic Compression (education): steady sustained pressure to MTrP at discomfort level 45-75s (1-3 passes), stop if sharp/electrical/nerve symptoms; then gentle lengthening into comfort; reassess tenderness + ROM.
points.stretch: Side-bend away (gentle), chin slightly tucked; reassess neck rotation comfort.
